location.description: android://[serial][/path]: the device to back up (its adb serial, or empty when a single device is connected) and the device path to back up (defaults to the shared storage, usually /storage/emulated/0)

serial.description: adb serial of the device, as shown by 'adb devices'; same as putting it in the location

source_path.description: Absolute device path to back up; overrides the path in the location

adb_server.description: host:port of the adb server (default 127.0.0.1:5037, or ANDROID_ADB_SERVER_PORT)

start_server.description: Run 'adb start-server' when no adb server answers on a local address

streams.description: Number of parallel file transfers over the adb link
